Privacy policy

ArchJobs · archjobs.velocitytechnologies.in · Last updated 24 October 2026

ArchJobs is a small job finder and application tracker for architecture and BIM roles, run by Velocity Technologies for a group of invited people. This page explains what it does with your information, in particular what it reads from your Gmail if you choose to connect it.

Signing in with Google

When you choose Continue with Google, Google shares your name, email address and profile picture with ArchJobs. These are used to create your account and show who is signed in. Only invited email addresses can join.

Gmail (optional)

Connecting Gmail is a separate step in Settings. It gives ArchJobs read-only access (the gmail.readonly permission). ArchJobs never sends, deletes, labels or changes anything in your mailbox. Every 30 minutes it searches your mailbox for two kinds of email only:

  • LinkedIn job alerts. The job postings in them (title, company, location, link) are added to the job list shared by everyone on ArchJobs. Nothing personal from the email is kept.
  • Emails about your own job applications, found by words in the subject such as application, interview, offer or assessment, and LinkedIn's “your application was sent” emails. Promotions and social emails are skipped. The first check looks back 60 days.

For each application email, ArchJobs works out whether it confirms an application, invites you to an interview or a test, makes an offer, or turns you down, and updates your own tracker. Other people on ArchJobs cannot see your tracker.

What is stored

  • Your account: name, email address, profile picture, and when you last signed in.
  • Your tracker entries, firms, searches and settings.
  • For each application email read: its Gmail message ID, sender address, subject, date, the label given to it (for example “interview”), and the company and role named in it, so the same email is never read twice. The body of your emails is not stored.
  • A short note on the tracker entry (date, label and subject line), and the sender's address as the contact when it is a person rather than an automated sender.
  • The permission Google gives ArchJobs to read your Gmail (a refresh token), encrypted with AES-256-GCM.

AI processing

To understand an application email, ArchJobs sends its sender, subject and the first part of its text (about 1,800 characters, without quoted earlier replies) to an AI model. The request goes through an AI gateway run by Velocity Technologies to the model provider (Groq), which returns the label, company and role. Your emails are not used to train AI models, and the answer is used only to update your tracker. If the AI is unavailable, simple keyword rules are used instead.

Google API Services User Data Policy

ArchJobs' use and transfer of information received from Google APIs to any other app will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. In particular:

  • Gmail data is used only to provide the features described above, which you can see in the app.
  • It is not sold, not used for advertising, and not used to build general AI or machine-learning models.
  • It is not shared with anyone except as needed to provide these features (the AI processing above), to comply with the law, or to keep the service secure.
  • No person reads your email, unless you ask for help with a problem and give permission, or it is needed for security or by law.

Cookies and other sites

ArchJobs uses one cookie to keep you signed in, and a short-lived one during Google sign-in. There are no advertising or tracking cookies and no third-party analytics.

The Companies page shows each firm's logo, loaded from DuckDuckGo's icon service (icons.duckduckgo.com), which therefore sees your IP address when that page opens. It sets no cookies. Nothing else on ArchJobs is loaded from another site.

Your choices

  • Disconnect Gmail any time in Settings. ArchJobs deletes its stored permission and withdraws it at Google, and stops reading your mailbox. You can also remove access at myaccount.google.com/permissions.
  • Delete your account by asking the owner (Settings → People, or the email below). This removes your tracker, firms, searches, settings, hidden jobs and the records of emails read. Job postings in the shared list stay, as they are not personal.
  • Edit or delete any tracker entry yourself in the app.

Where data is kept

ArchJobs runs on Hostinger servers. Data is kept for as long as your account exists, or until you disconnect Gmail (for the stored permission). Connections to ArchJobs use HTTPS.

Changes and contact

If this policy changes, the date at the top changes too, and anything that affects what is read from Gmail will be shown in the app first. Questions or requests: adityatakuli51@gmail.com.
